playcaller_change_lead28_reliability_sea.classification_evidence: 95% CI [-0.5674,+0.9187] crosses zero on 7 season-pairs; not resolved toward zero (no_split_half_reliability requires a resolved-at-zero reading, not merely a wide interval) and not a resolved positive.
playcaller_change_lead28_reliability_sea.description: LEAD-28 split-half reliability: post-bye new-OC-cover-rate minus veteran-OC-cover-rate, computed per season 2011-2024, correlated across 7 odd/even adjacent season pairs (2011-2012 ... 2023-2024).
playcaller_change_lead28_reliability_sea.notes: Spearman-Brown full-length correction +0.4241. Descriptive odd/even season-halves of the primary back-cell alone (not the interaction): odd seasons (154 games) gap -2.497 pts P+ 0.296; even seasons (149 games) gap -2.195 pts P+ 0.311 -- both halves lean the same direction as the pooled full-history read (-2.33 pts P+ 0.230). effect-units recorded as correlation (a Pearson r), not accuracy_points, because that is the quantity actually measured; see docs/playcaller_change_leads.md.
playcaller_change_lead28_reliability_sea.plain_summary: We checked whether the post-bye new-playcaller-vs-veteran pattern shows up consistently from one pair of seasons to the next; it leans toward yes (a positive but uncertain correlation), not toward no.

playcaller_change_lead29_reliability_odd.classification_evidence: playcaller_first_game is a rare in-season event flag (12 events, 4 seasons), not a repeated-measures per-team trait with enough seasons to correlate; a formal split-half coefficient does not apply (matches docs/snow_game_home_prep.md section 4 convention for thin per-event flags). Reported instead: odd-season half above, even-season half in notes. Neither refutes nor confirms.
playcaller_change_lead29_reliability_odd.description: LEAD-29 split-half reliability: first-game-after-playcaller-change cover gap vs population, measured independently on odd-numbered and even-numbered seasons of the R1 2020-2025 opener population (method not_applicable for a formal correlation: only 12 events across 4 seasons).
playcaller_change_lead29_reliability_odd.notes: Effect/interval/P+ above are the ODD-season half (7 first games, 2023+2025): gap +7.18 pts, 95% [-35.87,+50.20], P+ 0.6407. EVEN-season half (5 first games, 2022+2024): gap -10.03 pts, 95% [-50.10,+50.03], P+ 0.2858. Halves disagree in sign, as expected at n=7/n=5; not a zero-reliability closing ground, which requires a resolved-at-zero formal coefficient, not two noisy halves.
playcaller_change_lead29_reliability_odd.plain_summary: There are too few coordinator-change events (12, across just 4 seasons) to test whether this pattern repeats reliably from year to year; the two halves of the data we do have point in different directions, which is expected noise at this size, not a refutation.
